NewsArticle.Title: Rucesion Village - Advance Settlers
NewsArticle.Content:
Advance settlers will be able to become citizens of Rucesion, although mundane construction will not be prepared until 99.09.15.
See [full story.](http://www.darkages.com/2000/news/990915.html)
With continued population growth of about 500 simultaneous players online, another village will become home to Aislings. You're in your world now.
